responsibility: This module provides GCC’s core Register Transfer Language infrastructure: the fundamental RTL object model and metadata (rtl.def, rtl.h, rtl.cc), the generic analysis and traversal utilities used to inspect and hash RTL expressions and addresses (rtlanal*, rtl-iter.h, rtlhash*), and the common hooks, diagnostics, and support code that let backend passes manipulate, validate, and report on RTL (rtlhooks*, rtl-error*, insn-notes.def, insn-addr.h). It also contains the central RTL-side dataflow and register-usage framework (df-core, df-scan, df-problems, df.h, regstat) plus instruction recognition and change-validation support around machine descriptions (recog*), and scheduling-oriented dependence graph support (ddg*). Together these files define the shared low-level backend substrate for representing, scanning, analyzing, recognizing, and safely transforming RTL before target-specific optimization and final emission, distinguishing this module from higher-level GIMPLE/tree middle-end code and from target-specific backend directories.
